samples.question: The four tiles start in the recency rack from LEAST RECENT on the left to MOST RECENT on the right. Identify a tile by its black pip count: A=1, B=2, C=3, D=4. Read the eight ACCESS cards from left to right. On each card, the named tile moves exactly one slot toward MOST RECENT by swapping with its right neighbor; if it is already in the rightmost slot, nothing changes. Which tile is LEAST RECENT after all eight cards? Answer A, B, C, or D.
